description: Caption a meme template and get back the meme's page URL and direct image URL. One text is a bottom caption, two are top/bottom, more fill the template's caption boxes in order.

layout.description: "top" puts captions in a white bar above the image instead of overlaying

texts.description: Captions, top-to-bottom; each a string or an object

color.description: A hex value #rgb / #rrggbb or one of white, black, red, yellow, blue, green

outline.description: Same colour forms as color; omit and a readable outline is picked

name: create_meme
